headline: A second quiet day; scores ease slightly
body: Another day with no scored events. The board drifted only by hundredths as earlier stories counted for a little less each day: Libertarian Utopia, Protector God and Reversion eased slightly, while the darker endings held almost still. Horizon Balance is 2.4, down 0.02.
movers_note: No ending moved by 0.1 or more; Libertarian Utopia, Protector God and Reversion eased (-0.0) from fading.
